target_bugs.title: Misplaced overflow return always exits FP16 optimizer step
target_bugs.root_cause: return self.overflow at wrong indentation causes optimizer step to always return early
target_bugs.invariant: return self.overflow must be inside if self.overflow block, not if use_grad_scaling

target_bugs.title: Loss not decreasing when using overlap-param-gather with overlap-grad-reduce
target_bugs.root_cause: All-gather handle list in DistributedOptimizer not properly initialized. Causes stale handles, which makes FP16 loss scaler always detect inf, setting LR=0 and skipping all parameter updates.
target_bugs.invariant: After warmup, learning_rate > 0 and loss must decrease. All iterations skipped or LR=0 = bug.

target_bugs.title: MoE Router topk=1 with post-softmax gives trivial probabilities and zero gradient
target_bugs.root_cause: topk-then-softmax with k=1: softmax of single value is always 1.0, producing zero gradient for the router. Router weights never learn.
target_bugs.invariant: Router routing probabilities must have non-trivial distribution. All probs == 1.0 means zero gradient = bug.

target_bugs.title: preserve_rng_state incorrectly set to False with dropout
target_bugs.root_cause: Boolean condition inverted: preserve_rng_state = (all_dropout==0) instead of not(all_dropout==0)
target_bugs.invariant: When dropout > 0, preserve_rng_state must be True

target_bugs.title: Integer overflow when tracking global flops
target_bugs.root_cause: global_train_flops: int overflows after ~107K steps for 7B models
target_bugs.invariant: global flops tracking must use float to avoid overflow

target_bugs.title: A100 peak flops specification 2x too low
target_bugs.root_cause: A100 BF16 peak = 624 TFLOPS but code used 312 TFLOPS, inflating MFU to unrealistic values.
target_bugs.invariant: A100 BF16 peak flops must be 624 TFLOPS, not 312

target_bugs.title: Integer overflow in FusedAdam silently prevents weight updates for large tensors (>= 2^31 elements)
target_bugs.root_cause: TensorListMetadata 的 sizes 数组使用 int32，超过 2^31 个元素的 tensor 溢出为负值，CUDA kernel 循环不执行，参数和 optimizer state 不更新
target_bugs.detection_method: 大 tensor 的参数在 optimizer step 后 checksum 不变；权重更新量为零

target_bugs.title: Missing input validation for fp16 loss_scale accepts float('inf')
target_bugs.root_cause: fp16 配置的 loss_scale 接受 float('inf') 而不报错，导致梯度被 inf 缩放后悄悄变成 NaN
target_bugs.detection_method: loss_scale 为 inf；梯度出现 NaN 但无 validation error

target_bugs.title: Fix ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offloaded gradient loss with multiple backward() per step
target_bugs.root_cause: ga_steps > 1 条件阻止了 ga_steps=1 但有多次 backward 场景的梯度累积，中间 backward 的梯度被丢弃，参数偏差达 2e-3
target_bugs.detection_method: CPU offload 时参数值与非 offload 参考实现有 ~2x learning_rate 量级的偏差

target_bugs.title: Fix zero 1 and 2 CPU-offloaded gradient norm
target_bugs.root_cause: CPU offload 场景下 micro_step_id > 0 的梯度被丢弃而非累积到 CPU，导致梯度范数在首个 microstep 后冻结，严重低估真实梯度幅度
target_bugs.detection_method: gradient_accumulation_steps > 1 时梯度范数不随 microstep 增长

target_bugs.title: Fix: Update grad norm calculation for CPU offload
target_bugs.root_cause: CPU offload 下 gradient clipping 后 norm_for_param_grads 数据结构未更新，导致记录的梯度范数与实际 clipped 梯度不一致，梯度裁剪效果失效
target_bugs.detection_method: CPU offload 时 gradient clipping 后记录的 grad_norm 与实际梯度值不匹配

target_bugs.title: Fix sort of zero checkpoint files
target_bugs.root_cause: checkpoint 转换工具按字母顺序排序分片文件（10, 11, 9 而非 9, 10, 11），导致 optimizer state 碎片合并顺序错误，checkpoint 数据静默损坏
target_bugs.detection_method: universal checkpoint 转换后 optimizer state 的 checksum 与原始不匹配

target_bugs.title: Fix saving and loading model checkpoint logic for MiCS sharding
target_bugs.root_cause: MiCS 只有第一个 partition group 保存 checkpoint，其他 group 的数据丢失；加载时也缺少对 MiCS partition 的支持
target_bugs.detection_method: MiCS checkpoint 文件缺少非第一 partition group 的数据

target_bugs.title: MOE: Fix save checkpoint when TP > 1
target_bugs.root_cause: MoE checkpoint 保存仅保留 rank 0 的 model_states 文件，TP > 1 时其他 TP rank 的数据缺失
target_bugs.detection_method: TP > 1 时 checkpoint 目录中仅有 mp_rank_00_model_states.pt，缺少其他 TP rank 文件

target_bugs.title: seq_aux_loss + pad_to_capacity produces corrupted routing map and wrong load balancing loss
target_bugs.root_cause: When pad_to_capacity is enabled, dummy padded tokens corrupt the routing_map used for load-balancing loss computation. The auxiliary loss becomes constantly 1.0 instead of reflecting true token distribution across experts.
target_bugs.detection_method: Auxiliary load balancing loss is constant 1.0; routing_map includes padded tokens with zero probabilities

target_bugs.title: Incorrect softmax_factor in MLA using mscale instead of mscale_all_dim
target_bugs.root_cause: Multi-Head Latent Attention uses wrong scaling variable (mscale vs mscale_all_dim) for softmax_factor calculation. No error is thrown but attention scaling is mathematically incorrect, diverging from DeepSeek-V3 reference.
target_bugs.detection_method: Softmax scale factor value differs from reference implementation; attention output diverges

target_bugs.title: Fix data helpers overflow bug (int32 overflow in sample_idx)
target_bugs.root_cause: doc_idx_index (int64) is assigned to sample_idx (int32). When doc_idx_index exceeds int32 range during long training with short-sentence datasets, silent integer overflow produces wrong data indices, feeding incorrect training samples.
target_bugs.detection_method: sample_idx wraps around due to int32 overflow; wrong documents/samples are loaded for training

target_bugs.title: MXFP8 params without DP comm overlap causes NaN loss
target_bugs.root_cause: Using --fp8-param-gather and --reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag without --overlap-grad-reduce and --overlap-param-gather causes gradient buffer corruption leading to NaN. The gradient buffer reuse conflicts with non-overlapped communication.
target_bugs.detection_method: Loss becomes NaN; gradient buffer values corrupted due to premature reuse before communication completes

target_bugs.title: Fix bug of reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag
target_bugs.root_cause: When forward_pre_hook is disabled, finish_param_sync() is never called to zero the gradient buffer on the first iteration, so initial parameter values pollute the main gradients silently.
target_bugs.detection_method: Gradient buffer contains non-zero values before first backward; grad_norm abnormally large on first iteration

target_bugs.title: Optimizer state is empty when save-interval=20
target_bugs.root_cause: When saving checkpoint at iteration 20 with save-interval=20, optimizer state dict is missing 'exp_avg' key. The optimizer state hasn't been properly populated at early save points, leading to corrupt checkpoints.
target_bugs.detection_method: Checkpoint optimizer state is missing exp_avg/exp_avg_sq; KeyError on resume

target_bugs.title: Sequential OLMo block should not have shared layernorm
target_bugs.root_cause: Sequential transformer block 中 attention 和 FFN 路径共享了同一个 LayerNorm（self.norm），而 FFN 路径应该使用 self.norm2，导致两路归一化参数耦合
target_bugs.detection_method: FFN 路径和 attention 路径的 LayerNorm 输出完全相同（应该不同）；模型训练效果不佳但不会 crash

target_bugs.title: Changed from ignored_index to ignore_index for cross_entropy_loss (flash-attn API change)
target_bugs.root_cause: flash-attn >= 2.5.8 将 cross_entropy_loss 的参数名从 ignored_index 改为 ignore_index，但 OLMo 未同步更新，导致 ignore_index 参数未生效，padding token 被错误地计入 loss
target_bugs.detection_method: loss 值偏低（padding token 参与了 loss 计算使分母变大）；模型对 padding 位置产生了非零梯度

target_bugs.title: Fix bug with saving unsharded checkpoint
target_bugs.root_cause: 保存 unsharded checkpoint 时存在 bug，导致 checkpoint 状态不完整或不正确，从该 checkpoint 恢复训练会产生错误结果
target_bugs.detection_method: 从 unsharded checkpoint 恢复训练后，loss 与中断前不连续

target_bugs.title: Instance mask correction to avoid NaN loss
target_bugs.root_cause: Instance masking 实现中存在 bug，当 batch 中所有 token 都被 mask 时导致除以零产生 NaN loss
target_bugs.detection_method: 特定 batch 上 loss 突然变为 NaN；与 instance mask 中的全零 mask 相关

target_bugs.title: Fixed CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay scheduler initialization bug
target_bugs.root_cause: CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay 学习率 scheduler 的初始化逻辑错误，导致学习率 schedule 不符合预期
target_bugs.detection_method: 实际 learning rate schedule 与配置的 cosine+warmup+linear decay 不匹配

target_bugs.title: Fixed LM evaluator data-order drift across repeated runs via loader bookkeeping reset
target_bugs.root_cause: LM evaluator 的 data loader 在重复运行间存在数据顺序漂移，因为 bookkeeping state 未被正确重置，导致不同 eval run 看到不同顺序的数据
target_bugs.detection_method: 相同配置下多次 evaluation 结果不一致；data loader 的内部 index 状态在 run 之间未重置

target_bugs.title: Initialization bug in Attention/GatedDeltaNet: depth-scaled output projection init never applied
target_bugs.root_cause: Attention 和 GatedDeltaNet 中 depth-scaled output projection 初始化由于错误的自比较运算符（self-equality check）而从未生效，初始化使用了错误的 scale
target_bugs.detection_method: output projection 的初始化权重 scale 与配置的 depth-scaled init 不匹配；所有层的 output projection scale 相同（应随深度变化）

target_bugs.title: FSDP gradient accumulation outside no_sync() with CPU offloading yields incorrect results
target_bugs.root_cause: FSDP 在 no_sync() 外部做 gradient accumulation 且使用 CPU offloading 时，直接使用新 reduce 的梯度替代累积梯度，而非叠加
target_bugs.detection_method: gradient accumulation 时梯度未被正确累积；每次 accumulation step 的梯度覆盖了之前的梯度

target_bugs.title: FSDP use_orig_params + full sharding results in missing parameters in gathered state dict
target_bugs.root_cause: FSDP 在 use_orig_params=True + FULL_SHARD 策略下，inner module 的 state_dict 缺少部分子模块的参数，而 wrapped model 的 state_dict 包含正确的参数
target_bugs.detection_method: state_dict 中缺少部分参数；inner module 和 wrapped model 的 state_dict key 不一致

target_bugs.title: FSDP with param_init_fn + sync_module_states=True produces random accuracy (model not learning)
target_bugs.root_cause: FSDP 使用 param_init_fn 和 sync_module_states=True 时，因 re-initialization 在 flatten/shard 后改变了参数 shape 导致 RNG 序列不同，模型实际上无法学习但不报错
target_bugs.detection_method: accuracy 和 F1 保持随机水平（模型未学习）；loss 看似下降但实际效果为零

target_bugs.title: Fixed bug attempting to save duplicate final checkpoint on restart
target_bugs.root_cause: 训练从 checkpoint 恢复后，trainer 尝试重复保存最终 checkpoint，可能覆盖已有的正确 checkpoint
target_bugs.detection_method: 恢复训练后在最终 step 保存了重复的 checkpoint；checkpoint 文件被覆盖

target_bugs.title: clip_grad_norm_ uses torch.max instead of torch.min for clip_coef
target_bugs.root_cause: deepspeed/runtime/utils.py:clip_grad_norm_ used torch.max(1, max_norm/total_norm) so clip_coef=1 when grads exceed threshold (no clipping). Fix changes max -> min so clip_coef<=1 properly clips.
target_bugs.invariant: After clip_grad_norm_, ||grad|| must be <= max_norm (within tolerance)

target_bugs.title: AdamWConfig.build does not set initial_lr on param_groups; restart-time peak LR lost
target_bugs.root_cause: build() returned torch.optim.AdamW without setting initial_lr. PyTorch LRScheduler with last_epoch>=0 requires initial_lr in each param_group; without it, peak LR after restart is lost.
target_bugs.invariant: after AdamWConfig.build(model), every param_group must contain key 'initial_lr'

target_bugs.title: single_all_to_all routes uneven-head path on second all2all when divisibility fails
target_bugs.root_cause: Buggy gate `if get_num_kv_heads() is not None or num_heads % seq_world_size != 0` routes to uneven_heads_all2all even on the second all2all when divisibility fails. Uneven path does not produce correct output for second all2all.
target_bugs.invariant: On second all2all (scatter_idx<2) with divisibility failure and kv_heads None, must NOT take uneven_heads_all2all path

target_bugs.title: seq_parallel_communication_data_type config key typo causes silent ignore
target_bugs.root_cause: SEQ_PARALLEL_COMMUNICATION_DATA_TYPE constant uses 'seq_parallel_comm_data_type' but config uses 'seq_parallel_communication_data_type'
target_bugs.invariant: User-specified seq_parallel_communication_data_type must be reflected in parsed engine config

target_bugs.title: ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offload gradient norm underestimated with manual GA
target_bugs.root_cause: copy_grads_in_partition only accumulates when ga_steps > 1, misses micro_step_id > 0 case
target_bugs.invariant: CPU gradient buffer must be updated on every micro-step when cpu_offload is enabled

target_bugs.title: ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offload gradient loss with multiple backward() per step
extra_large_param uses param.dtype instead of comm_dtype — gradient silently dropped
BF16_Optimizer incorrectly selected for bf16+fp32_grad_accum without ZeRO
bf16 without ZeRO incorrectly treated as having ZeRO optimizer state in checkpoint
Frozen parameters included in optimizer groups
target_bugs.invariant: Optimizer groups must only contain params with requires_grad=True

target_bugs.title: ZeRO step uses post-decay loss_scale to unscale grad norm instead of prev_scale used during backward
target_bugs.root_cause: In DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer.step, _global_grad_norm was computed as scaled_global_grad_norm / self.loss_scale. But self.loss_scale is the *new* scale (already updated for this step), while the gradients that produced scaled_global_grad_norm were scaled by the *previous* scale (prev_scale). Dividing by the wrong scale silently skews the global grad norm used for clipping.
target_bugs.invariant: self._global_grad_norm * prev_scale must equal scaled_global_grad_norm for the step (i.e. unscaling uses the same factor that backward applied).

target_bugs.title: Sparse gradients silently not updating — SparseTensor wraps .data instead of param.grad
target_bugs.root_cause: In _get_gradients_for_reduction, the sparse-gradient branch wrapped `param.grad.data` into a SparseTensor: `grad_data = SparseTensor(grad_data)`. Because Python re-bound the local name and never wrote back into param.grad, the post-allreduce updated values were stored on a temporary SparseTensor that had no link to the parameter — the sparse embedding gradients were silently dropped.
target_bugs.invariant: After buffered_allreduce_fallback, param.grad of a sparse-gradient parameter must reflect the all-reduced values (non-zero where local grad was non-zero).

target_bugs.title: ZeRO3 builds fp16 partitions from full param_groups including frozen params, OOM-equivalent silent waste plus unused opt
target_bugs.root_cause: DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3._setup_for_real_optimizer called _create_fp16_partitions_with_defragmentation() on the raw self.optimizer.param_groups, including frozen params. Frozen params became part of the partitioned trainable list — they were placed into Adam fp32 state and received update increments from optimizer.step, silently un-freezing them.
target_bugs.invariant: Across optimizer steps, p.data must remain unchanged for every nn.Parameter with requires_grad=False.

target_bugs.title: ZeRO optimizer.step() called once during initialization, increments Adam step counter before any real update
target_bugs.root_cause: All ZeRO/BF16 wrappers eagerly called the inner optimizer's step() during construction in order to materialize state tensors. This silently incremented the Adam state[`step`] counter for every param before any real backward pass, so the bias-correction terms were off by one (and beta1^t / beta2^t for the first few real steps were wrong) compared to vanilla PyTorch.
target_bugs.invariant: Right after deepspeed.initialize, optimizer.state[p]['step'] must equal 0 for every parameter p (no fake step has run).

target_bugs.title: DeepSpeedDataLoader.len reports sampler length, ignores batch_size and drop_last
target_bugs.root_cause: DeepSpeedDataLoader.__init__ set self.len = len(self.data_sampler), the count of underlying samples. Callers using len(dataloader) (e.g. lr scheduler total_num_steps, progress bars, max_steps detection) silently received the sample count instead of the batch count, off by ~batch_size× — schedules and step counters silently drift.
target_bugs.invariant: len(DeepSpeedDataLoader) must equal len(sampler)//batch_size when drop_last=True, else ceil(len(sampler)/batch_size).

target_bugs.title: ZeRO2 extra_large_param leaks reference when contiguous_gradients=False — silent stale-grad reduction in next step
target_bugs.root_cause: reduce_independent_p_g_buckets_and_remove_grads set `self.extra_large_param_to_reduce = param` whenever a param exceeded reduce_bucket_size, regardless of contiguous_gradients. With contiguous_gradients=False the IPG buffer path is never taken, so the assignment was a dead store but the reference outlived the iteration. On the next backward pass the ipg-flush code saw the stale extra_large_param_t
target_bugs.invariant: self.extra_large_param_to_reduce must be None (or never set) when self.contiguous_gradients is False.

target_bugs.title: MoE checkpoint records dp_world_size instead of seq_dp_world_size — wrong replication factor on resume with sequence par
target_bugs.root_cause: _save_checkpoint writes the global dp_world_size into the state-dict's 'dp_world_size' field for MoE expert checkpoints. When sequence parallel is also enabled the relevant DP world size is seq_dp_world_size = dp_world_size / sp_size. On resume the checkpoint loader uses this value to re-shard expert tensors, producing the wrong split: experts get replicated/sliced across SP ranks instead of acros
target_bugs.invariant: After load_checkpoint, every MoE expert parameter on rank r must bit-equal the corresponding fragment that rank r wrote into the saved checkpoint.

target_bugs.title: topkgating drop_tokens=False does not recompute locations after capacity update — dispatch positions stale
target_bugs.root_cause: When drop_tokens=False, topkgating computes new_capacity via all_reduce(MAX) over expert counts, then assigns capacity=new_capacity. But it forgets to recompute `locations = torch.cumsum(mask, dim=0) - 1` after this capacity update path. The old `locations` from a stale earlier mask is used to scatter tokens into expert slots — so tokens go into the wrong dispatch positions, and the combine_weight
target_bugs.invariant: After the drop_tokens branch in topkgating, locations[i,j] must equal cumsum(mask[:,j])[i] - 1 for every (i,j) where mask[i,j]==1.

target_bugs.title: ZeRO-3 CPU offload set_local_grad does not refresh norm_for_param_grads — gradient clipping uses pre-clipping norm
target_bugs.root_cause: set_local_grad copies the supplied tensor into the fp32 partition's grad slot but does not update self.norm_for_param_grads[param_id]. With CPU offload, scaled_global_grad_norm is later computed as the L2-aggregate of these cached per-param norms (because the actual grad lives in pinned CPU memory). The aggregate therefore reflects pre-modification gradients, while unscale_and_clip_grads applies a
target_bugs.invariant: Whenever fp32 grad partition for param p is overwritten via set_local_grad, norm_for_param_grads[p] must equal _constant_buffered_norm2 of the new gradient.

target_bugs.title: ZeRO-0 + torch.autocast(fp16) trains without a GradScaler — fp16 gradients underflow to zero
target_bugs.root_cause: init_autocast_params installed lower-precision modules without instantiating a torch.amp.GradScaler. Because ZeRO stage 0 + torch.autocast doesn't go through any DeepSpeed loss-scaler path, backward propagated unscaled fp16 grads — anything below ~6e-5 magnitude flushes to 0. The optimizer step then applies near-zero updates and training stalls / converges to a degenerate solution.
target_bugs.invariant: When torch_autocast is enabled with dtype=fp16 and zero_optimization stage is 0, a non-trivial loss-scale must be applied before loss.backward (loss.grad_fn.scale > 1).

target_bugs.title: ZeRO-1/2 IPG buffer averaged over full allocated size — averages garbage from unused tail elements
target_bugs.root_cause: In average_tensor's contiguous_gradients/non-extra-large branch, the code passed `self.ipg_buffer[self.ipg_index]` (the whole pre-allocated buffer of size reduce_bucket_size) to average_tensor. When the bucket flushes early (e.g. last params of a step or after a dtype switch), only elements_in_ipg_bucket are valid; the tail still holds whatever was last computed there. Those stale floats get inclu
target_bugs.invariant: The tensor passed to average_tensor must be exactly self.ipg_buffer.narrow(0, 0, self.elements_in_ipg_bucket).

target_bugs.title: ZeRO-3 partition padding allocated with torch.empty — undefined values get reduced into other ranks' partitions
target_bugs.root_cause: When a parameter's last partition is smaller than partition_numel, _avg_scatter_dense_grads built a padded_partition with `torch.empty(...)` and only copied the valid prefix into it. The trailing pad elements held arbitrary garbage from the GPU allocator. That whole padded tensor was then included in the reduce_scatter, so other ranks received contaminated padding bytes mixed into the next paramet
target_bugs.invariant: Any padding bytes appended to a per-param grad partition before reduce-scatter must be exactly zero.

target_bugs.title: CPU Adam/Adagrad uses params.size(0) instead of numel() — only the first row of multi-dim params gets updated
target_bugs.root_cause: ds_adam_step / ds_adagrad_step (and the *_plus_copy variants) passed `params_c.size(0)` (the size of the FIRST dimension only) as the element count to the kernel's Step_8. For a Linear weight of shape (out, in), only `out` elements are stepped instead of `out*in`. The kernel happily walks `size(0)` floats from the data pointer (which is in-bounds) and writes back only those — the other (size(0)*(s
target_bugs.invariant: After CPU Adam step, every element of every parameter tensor must change by exactly the Adam-prescribed update (within fp32 tolerance) — none should remain at its prior value.

target_bugs.title: WarmupLR / LRRangeTest / OneCycle do not initialize optimizer group lr at construction — first step uses original lr
target_bugs.root_cause: WarmupLR.__init__ stored its desired schedule but never wrote min_lr into self.optimizer.param_groups[0]['lr']. As a result, when the engine's first optimizer.step() runs (before lr_scheduler.step() which by convention is called after), the optimizer uses whatever lr the user instantiated the optimizer with — typically the peak lr — for one full step instead of the scheduler's warmup_min_lr (e.g.
target_bugs.invariant: After lr_scheduler construction (with last_batch_iteration == -1), every optimizer.param_groups[i]['lr'] must equal scheduler.get_lr()[i].

target_bugs.title: WarmupLR ignores optimizer LR, always uses hardcoded 0.001
target_bugs.root_cause: warmup_max_lr defaults to 0.001 instead of inheriting from optimizer param_groups
target_bugs.invariant: After warmup, LR must equal optimizer's configured LR, not a hardcoded default

target_bugs.title: BF16 optimizer lp_grads not cleared after HP accumulation
target_bugs.root_cause: clear_lp_grads=False should be True in accumulate_hp_grads_and_remove_lp
target_bugs.invariant: lp_grads must be cleared after accumulation to prevent stale gradient buildup

target_bugs.title: FusedAdam.use_decoupled_grad not set for Megatron-FSDP, gradients silently ignored
target_bugs.root_cause: When Megatron-FSDP is paired with FusedAdam, gradients are written to param.decoupled_grad rather than param.grad. FusedAdam's use_decoupled_grad flag was never set to True, so the optimizer kept reading param.grad (which is None or stale), silently skipping the actual gradient update.
target_bugs.invariant: When using Megatron-FSDP with FusedAdam, optimizer.use_decoupled_grad must be True and at least one parameter must have a non-zero decoupled_grad before optimizer.step().

target_bugs.title: CUDA-graph warmup overwrites MoE router expert_bias persistent buffer
target_bugs.root_cause: _CudaGraphRunner saved/restored parameter grads before graph warmup, but did not save persistent buffers. The router's expert_bias buffer is updated in-place each forward by _apply_expert_bias(); warmup forward passes mutated it, and the post-capture state diverged from the pre-capture state, silently corrupting routing for latent MoE models.
target_bugs.invariant: After _CudaGraphRunner warmup completes, every persistent buffer of base_module must equal its pre-warmup value (bitwise).

target_bugs.title: Megatron-FSDP precision-aware optimizer keeps duplicate FusedAdam master_weights
target_bugs.root_cause: When constructing the per-model-chunk optimizer for Megatron-FSDP, the code did not override FusedAdam's master_weights flag. FusedAdam allocated and used its own internal master weights instead of relying on Megatron-FSDP's main weights, so optimizer updates were applied to a stale duplicate copy that never received gradient updates.
target_bugs.invariant: When use_megatron_fsdp and use_precision_aware_optimizer are both True, optimizer.optimizer.master_weights must be False.

target_bugs.title: mxfp8 reuse_grad_buf zeros wrong buffer (grad_data instead of param_data)
target_bugs.root_cause: After all-gather of params completed for a bucket, the code zeroed bucket.grad_data to prepare for gradient accumulation. Because grad/param buffers share storage and one grad buffer may correspond to multiple param buffers, this also wiped out param data of other buckets that had not yet completed all-gather, silently corrupting weights.
target_bugs.invariant: After bucket finish_param_sync, no other bucket's param_data within the same buffer should be all zeros (unless intentionally so).

target_bugs.title: FSDP grad accumulation fusion missing main_grad creation in linear backward
target_bugs.root_cause: LinearWithGradAccumulationAndAsyncCommunication.backward called fused_weight_gradient_mlp_cuda.wgrad_gemm_accum_fp32 directly with weight.main_grad, but for Megatron-FSDP parameters main_grad must be reconstructed in-place via weight.get_main_grad() each iteration. Without this call main_grad pointed to a stale buffer, so accumulated weight gradients were wrong.
target_bugs.invariant: If hasattr(weight, '__fsdp_param__'), weight.main_grad after backward must equal weight.get_main_grad().

target_bugs.title: use_decoupled_grad set wrong for bf16 + use_precision_aware_optimizer
target_bugs.root_cause: The condition for enabling FusedAdam master_weights was 'if config.main_params_dtype != torch.float32 or config.fp8_recipe == "delayed"'. This was True for bf16 main params even when the higher-level path (e.g. TE-managed master weights) should have owned them, double-managing master copies and silently using wrong precision in the optimizer step.
target_bugs.invariant: FusedAdam master_weights flag must equal config.use_precision_aware_optimizer_no_fp8_or_ds_fp8.

target_bugs.title: group_limited_topk used hardcoded k=2 instead of num_groups/group_topk
target_bugs.root_cause: group_limited_topk computed group_scores as scores.view(num_tokens, num_groups, -1).topk(2, dim=-1)[0].sum(dim=-1) — the k=2 was hardcoded instead of using num_groups//group_topk. target_bugs.title: MoE topk=1 gradient is silently zero because softmax is applied post-topk on a [N,1] tensor
target_bugs.root_cause: topk_softmax_with_capacity selected topk first then applied softmax: scores=topk(logits,k=1); probs=softmax(scores,dim=-1). With k=1, softmax of a length-1 vector is constant 1.0 with zero gradient w.r.t. logits, so the router weight received no learning signal at all when topk=1.

Inner optimizers' load_state_dict replaces their internal param_groups dict, so the outer ChainedOptimizer kept references to the OLD param_groups. target_bugs.title: MoE local_indices wrong via fancy indexing on bool mask when topk > 1
target_bugs.root_cause: BaseMoELayer used local_indices = global_indices[global_local_map] (fancy indexing). For 2-D global_indices with topk>1, advanced indexing collapses dimensions in a way that breaks the (token, expert_slot) layout, resulting in tokens being routed to the wrong experts on each EP rank. masked_select preserves the correct flat ordering.

target_bugs.title: MXFP8 reuse_grad_buf pollutes main grads on first iter when forward_pre_hook is disabled
target_bugs.root_cause: train_step unconditionally called optim_instance._copy_main_params_to_param_buffer() whenever reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag and overlap_param_gather were both set. target_bugs.root_cause: get_vit_layer_with_local_spec set self_attention attn_mask_type to AttnMaskType.causal. target_bugs.title: _CudagraphReplayNode unconditionally copies user_input into cudagraph_input even when the data pointers already match, o

target_bugs.title: DDP cast cudagraph manager runs warmup steps and shares mempool across virtual pipeline stages, corrupting captured para
target_bugs.root_cause: _ParamAndGradBucketGroup created a CudaGraphManager for copy_params_from_grad_buffer without num_warmup_steps=0, so the cast graph was warmed up before capture. target_bugs.root_cause: _build_model_and_main_param_groups built shard_model_param as model_param.view(-1)[range] without .detach(). target_bugs.invariant: For every param in bucket, bucket.param_to_index[param] must equal (param_index_map[param][0] - bucket.offset, param_index_map[param][1] - bucket.offset).

When selective recompute later invoked the saved tensor for backward, it operated on the quantized tensor instead of the bf16 original input, producing a recompute that mismatches the forward.
target_bugs.invariant: set_save_original_input must be called on TELinear modules whenever (config.fp8 with non-delayed recipe and TE>=2.6.0dev0) OR (config.fp4 and TE>=2.7.0.dev0).

target_bugs.title: MultimodalRotaryEmbedding slices rotary embedding along the wrong dimension and omits cp_group when CP is enabled, so ea
target_bugs.root_cause: After emb.transpose(0, 1).contiguous() the sequence dimension is index 0, but get_pos_emb_on_this_cp_rank was called with seq_dim=1 and no cp_group argument. The wrong axis was sharded across CP ranks, and the default global cp_group fallback was used instead of the configured one. Each CP rank ended up with a rotary slice that does not correspond to its own sequence partition.
target_bugs.invariant: MultimodalRotaryEmbedding output for CP rank r must equal get_pos_emb_on_this_cp_rank(global_emb, seq_dim=0, group=cp_group) for the configured cp_group.

target_bugs.root_cause: MambaStack.forward stored the result of make_viewless_tensor in a local variable 'output', but the function ultimately returned hidden_states. So the explicit make_viewless_tensor call had no effect. The non-viewless tensor (still a view onto an internal buffer) was returned and forwarded to the next PP stage via isend; on a hybrid VPP schedule the underlying buffer was reused before isend complet
target_bugs.invariant: MambaStack.forward must return a tensor that is viewless (.is_view() == False) so its storage is not aliased with internal stack buffers.

target_bugs.title: Hybrid DSL CommonLayerConfig does not derive params_dtype from mixed_precision_dtype, so models with mixed_precision_dty
target_bugs.root_cause: The DSL allowed bf16 mixed-precision compute while keeping params_dtype at fp32, producing a TransformerConfig with bf16=True but params_dtype=torch.float32. The legacy --bf16 CLI path automatically aligns params_dtype with bf16, so the DSL path silently diverged: parameters were materialized in fp32 and then cast on every forward, doubling memory and changing numerics relative to the legacy path.
target_bugs.invariant: When TransformerConfig.bf16 is True (mixed_precision_dtype='bf16') and the recipe leaves params_dtype at the fp32 default, the produced TransformerConfig.params_dtype must equal torch.bfloat16.

target_bugs.root_cause: MegatronOptimizer.get_grads_for_norm gated on getattr(param, '__fsdp_param__', False) FIRST and only fell back to the precision-aware decoupled_grad branch when not an FSDP param. With both flags on, FSDP parameters were always read via param.grad._local_tensor instead of param.decoupled_grad. Under precision-aware optimizer, param.grad is None or stale because gradients are written into param.dec
target_bugs.invariant: When config.use_precision_aware_optimizer_no_fp8_or_ds_fp8 is True, get_grads_for_norm must use param.decoupled_grad (with ._local_tensor when also __fsdp_param__) and never use param.grad.

target_bugs.title: Hybrid MoE pad_granularity is set to 32 (MXFP8) instead of 128 (HybridEP), so per-CP-rank sequence shards are misaligned
target_bugs.root_cause: HybridCPDataLoaderWrapper used pad_granularity = 32 (MXFP8 block size) when computing per-rank padding. HybridEP requires alignment to 128 elements. With granularity 32, per-CP-rank shards landed at offsets that did not satisfy HybridEP's 128-element alignment, so the dispatcher's load/store kernels read/wrote across token boundaries, mixing tokens between adjacent ranks.
target_bugs.invariant: HybridCPDataLoaderWrapper.pad_granularity must equal 128 when HybridEP is enabled (instead of 32).

target_bugs.root_cause: MegatronOptimizer.get_grads_for_norm and clip_grad_by_total_norm_fp32 dispatched on self.config.use_precision_aware_optimizer. With FP8 enabled, decoupled_grad is intentionally NOT used for those parameters; they should fall back to param.grad. The buggy gate took the precision-aware path anyway, attempting to read param.decoupled_grad (which is None), so grads_for_norm came back empty and grad_no
target_bugs.invariant: When config.fp8 is set or config.fp8_recipe in the DS_FP8 family, get_grads_for_norm must follow the param.grad branch (not param.decoupled_grad).

target_bugs.root_cause: num_fwd_flops/num_bck_flops were computed per sequence (multiplied by max_sequence_length) and SpeedMonitor accumulated them with global_batch_size every step using +=. After resume, the running total was overwritten/reset per step rather than treated as cumulative tokens, so reported Gflops did not accumulate across resumes. Fix changes flops to per-token and assigns Gflops = (fwd+bck) * global_t

target_bugs.title: torch.device('mps') used as boolean check is always truthy, forces every run into MPS/CPU mode
target_bugs.root_cause: The condition `if torch.device('mps')` is always True because torch.device(...) returns a non-None Device object. As a result the script unconditionally rewrites init_device to 'mps' and disables distributed training even on CUDA hosts. Fix replaces the call with torch.backends.mps.is_available() and a corresponding CPU check.
target_bugs.invariant: after script bootstrap, cfg.distributed_strategy and cfg.model.init_device must reflect the actual available backend (CUDA when torch.cuda.is_available())

target_bugs.root_cause: OLMo.reset_parameters always called init_normal on transformer.ff_out, including under muP where ff_out is a MuReadout that must be initialized to zero. target_bugs.invariant: for use_mup=true (and default mlp_hidden_size), each block's ff_proj.weight must have non-zero std after initialization
