target_bugs.invariant: After warmup, learning rate must be monotonically decreasing toward warmup_min_lr; not constant

target_bugs.title: DeepSpeed warmup_min_lr=0 instead of base_lr*0.1, also missing warmup_type=linear
target_bugs.root_cause: DeepSpeedTrainer hard-coded `warmup_min_lr=0.0` and omitted `warmup_type='linear'`. Combined, the warmup ramp starts from exactly 0 (rather than 10% of base lr) and uses DeepSpeed's default warmup interpolation, producing a different shape than the OLMo trainer for the equivalent config. Training runs to completion but with a silently mismatched warmup schedule.
target_bugs.invariant: DeepSpeed warmup LR profile must match the OLMo trainer's warmup profile for an equivalent configuration

target_bugs.title: Newest checkpoint deleted by retention policy because it is appended after pruning
target_bugs.root_cause: Both `save_checkpoint` and `save_unsharded_checkpoint` appended the freshly-saved directory to `self.checkpoints`/`self.unsharded_checkpoints` *after* the deletion loop. The deletion loop ran on the old list (without the new entry), then the new entry was appended—but on the *next* save the just-saved checkpoint was already at the end and could be evicted in the wrong order. The fix appends before
target_bugs.invariant: After save_checkpoint(N), the directory step{N} must remain on disk and self.checkpoints must reflect the actual contents of save_folder

target_bugs.title: Train DataLoader max_steps not multiplied by device_train_batch_size
target_bugs.root_cause: `build_train_dataloader` passed `max_steps=train_config.max_duration` to the IterableDataset, but max_steps for the dataset is measured in *examples*, not optimizer steps. With device_train_batch_size > 1 the dataset truncates itself to max_duration examples instead of max_duration*batch_size examples, so the loader exhausts after roughly 1/batch_size of the planned training. Likewise `start_step`
target_bugs.invariant: Total examples yielded by train loader = max_duration * device_train_batch_size

target_bugs.title: Fused cross_entropy path passes lse_square_scale=0 so z-loss term is silently dropped
target_bugs.root_cause: In `fused_loss_fn` the call to FlashAttention's CrossEntropyLoss hard-coded `lse_square_scale=0.0`. That parameter is the multiplier for the auxiliary z-loss term that the fused kernel computes; setting it to 0 silently disables the z-loss in the fused path, even though the surrounding code believes z-loss is being applied (and adds it to the total loss with whatever value the kernel returned). Wi
target_bugs.invariant: z_loss returned by fused_loss_fn must have the same magnitude as z_loss returned by the python reference cross_entropy_loss for the same inputs

target_bugs.title: Ladder script uses eos_token_id=0 instead of dolma tokenizer's 50279
target_bugs.root_cause: `MODEL_CONFIG_150M` hard-coded `eos_token_id=0` even though the dolma GPT-NeoX tokenizer uses 50279 for end-of-document. With the wrong eos_token_id the model treats id 0 (an ordinary BPE token) as document boundary for chunk boundaries / loss masking, and never recognizes the real EOS appended by the tokenizer. Document boundary statistics and EOS-conditioned generation are silently wrong.
target_bugs.invariant: model.eos_token_id must equal tokenizer.eos_token_id (50279 for dolma GPT-NeoX)

target_bugs.title: Wrong layer initialized — ff_out instead of ff_proj (variable name typo)
Attention claude-init uses d_model**-0.5 instead of actual w.in_features**-0.5 — wrong std for GQA Q/K/V and w_out
target_bugs.root_cause: InitMethod.attention used a single std = d_model**-0.5 for Q/K/V and w_out. Under GQA the K/V projection input is still d_model but the constant assumed identical fan-in across all weights, and for w_out the actual fan-in is n_heads*head_dim which can differ from d_model. Initialization was therefore silently scaled wrong on these layers.
target_bugs.invariant: Init std for each linear layer w must equal w.in_features**-0.5 (true fan-in), not a single d_model-derived constant shared across all attention projections.

target_bugs.title: Per-document RoPE positions not propagated when cu_doc_lens is provided in packed mode
target_bugs.root_cause: Attention.forward called self.rope(...) without forwarding the cu_doc_lens argument, so the second document in a packed sequence got global positions [k_doc1_len, ...] instead of restarting at 0. Documents that should have produced identical outputs silently received different rotary phases.
target_bugs.invariant: For two identical documents packed back-to-back, the post-RoPE q/k for both segments must match (intra-doc positions reset at each cu_doc_lens boundary).

target_bugs.title: RotaryEmbedding cu_doc_lens path miscomputes positions for B>1 — second batch element reuses batch-0 doc layout
target_bugs.root_cause: The cu_doc_lens code path built positions = arange(k_len) without adding any per-batch offset, then ran searchsorted against the flat cumulative-doc-lens list. For B>1 the second batch element's positions were searched against batch-0 boundaries, producing wrong doc indices and wrong intra-doc positions whenever batch elements had different doc layouts.
target_bugs.invariant: Local positions computed for each (batch, token) must equal token_index minus the start of that token's document; batch elements with identical doc structure must give identical local_positions.

target_bugs.title: GatedDeltaNet A_log/dt_bias initialized as empty (uninit memory) and miss the GDN-prescribed init
target_bugs.root_cause: GatedDeltaNet's A_log was initialized via torch.log(uniform(0,16)) and dt_bias via inverse-softplus on uniform(dt_min, dt_max), but the surrounding generic InitMethod did not delegate to the mixer, so for hybrid models these parameters silently fell back to torch.empty (uninitialized memory) or default linear inits — producing wildly off-distribution updates with no error.
target_bugs.invariant: After init, GDN A_log lies in log(uniform(0,16)) and dt_bias is the inverse-softplus of dt sampled in [dt_min, dt_max]; their distribution must be checkable against this prescription.

target_bugs.title: OLMo midtraining mix key references the wrong file — '0625' name maps to '0725' path
target_bugs.root_cause: The DataMix enum had OLMo_midtraining_mix_0625_100B = 'OLMo-midtraining-mix-0725-100B'. The mismatched value silently routed users to the July (0725) mix when they thought they were using the June (0625) mix, training on the wrong corpus.
target_bugs.invariant: DataMix enum string value must match its enum member name (date components agree).

target_bugs.title: Activation checkpointing skips RNG state preservation even when dropout is active — backward recomputes a different mask
target_bugs.root_cause: Transformer.apply_activation_checkpointing hard-coded preserve_rng_state=False with a TODO. With dropout active, the recomputed forward in backward used a fresh random mask, so backward gradients corresponded to a different forward graph than the one used to produce the loss — silently wrong gradients and degraded convergence.
target_bugs.invariant: If any nn.Dropout module exists, the forward run during backward recompute must use the same RNG state as the original forward (preserve_rng_state=True).

target_bugs.title: Expert/router gradients zeroed unconditionally in train_batch — first-half mask applied even when freeze_experts is off
target_bugs.root_cause: The base TransformerTrainModule.train_batch unconditionally walked named_parameters and zeroed the first half of expert and router gradients. The freeze logic was supposed to only run for the FreezeTransformerTrainModule subclass, but its train_batch override had been moved to module level, so the parent ran the masking on every regular training run silently — half of every expert never got update
target_bugs.invariant: When freeze_experts is unset/'none', no expert or router parameter gradient may be force-zeroed by the train module.

target_bugs.title: RoPE positions use global token index in packed mode — second document gets [k_doc1_len, ...] instead of [0, ...]
target_bugs.root_cause: RotaryEmbedding.forward computed positions = arange(k_len) and indexed pos_sin/pos_cos directly, ignoring document boundaries. Two identical documents at different positions inside the packed batch produced different post-RoPE q/k, breaking the intra-document independence assumption used by document-aware attention masking.
target_bugs.invariant: Two identical documents packed back-to-back must yield identical post-RoPE q/k values (per-document positions reset at each cu_doc_lens boundary).

target_bugs.title: SamplingInstanceSource cache write race — concurrent ladder runs overwrite each other's index files
target_bugs.root_cause: Local rank-0 always rewrote the indices file at startup. Concurrent jobs sharing the work directory raced via tmp_path.replace, leaving training reading partially-written or shuffled indices. Because the file name embeds the fingerprint, the contents are guaranteed identical, so silently using a stale half-written file (or rebuilding into the same name as another job) gave inconsistent ordering ac
target_bugs.invariant: If the deterministic-fingerprint indices file already exists, the rank must not rewrite it; cross-rank reads of the file must agree.

target_bugs.title: memmap_to_write tmp filename uses seeded random — concurrent writers collide on identical path under the same RNG seed
target_bugs.root_cause: memmap_to_write picked the temp filename via random.randint(0, 2**32) seeded by the global Python RNG. With identical seeds across ranks, each rank generated the same tmp_path; one rank's tmp_path.replace removed the file another rank was about to read, causing FileNotFoundError-style silent data shadowing or partial-content reads when a fallback masked the error.
target_bugs.invariant: Concurrent writers of the same file must use unique temp paths (entropy independent of the deterministic seed) and a missing tmp_path due to a concurrent rename must succeed if the destination exists.

target_bugs.title: DTPBoundaryPredictor calls F.silu with two arguments — silu treats w3(h) as inplace flag, drops gating
target_bugs.root_cause: The expression F.silu(self.w1(h), self.w3(h)) passed self.w3(h) as the inplace argument of F.silu (PyTorch interprets the second positional as a bool-coerced inplace flag). The intended SwiGLU gate (silu(w1(h)) * w3(h)) never executed, so the FFN computed silu(w1(h)) alone and the boundary predictor produced silently degraded outputs.
target_bugs.invariant: FFN must implement gated SwiGLU: out = w2(silu(w1(h)) * w3(h)); silu must be called with exactly one tensor argument.

target_bugs.title: sqrt decay LR schedule uses wrong formula — decay curve inverted
target_bugs.root_cause: sqrt(progress) instead of 1-sqrt(1-progress) — wrong decay curve shape
target_bugs.invariant: sqrt decay should decay fast initially, slow at end

target_bugs.title: MoE sigmoid router gives F.sigmoid(logits) without epsilon — exact-zero scores propagate as NaN through downstream log
target_bugs.root_cause: scores = F.sigmoid(logits) could underflow to exactly 0.0 under low precision, and downstream load-balancing or aux-loss code took log/divide of the score, producing -inf/NaN that silently propagated into the final loss without any explicit error.
target_bugs.invariant: Router score for gating_function=sigmoid must be strictly positive (>= eps) so subsequent log/divide operations are finite.

target_bugs.title: fan_in init for embeddings ignores embed_scale — embeddings remain std=1.0 and become huge after scaling
target_bugs.root_cause: init_embeddings under fan_in always used std=1.0. The transformer then multiplied embeddings by embed_scale (e.g., sqrt(d_model)) at the input, producing embeddings several orders of magnitude larger than intended. Training did not error but the input magnitude scrambled the early-layer dynamics.
target_bugs.invariant: After init_embeddings followed by the embed_scale multiply, the embedding output std must stay near 1.0 (compensating the fan-in init by 1/embed_scale).

target_bugs.title: ComplexRotaryEmbedding ignores cu_doc_lens — packed-document positions never reset for complex-RoPE blocks
target_bugs.root_cause: ComplexRotaryEmbedding.forward did not accept cu_doc_lens, so even when callers tried to enable per-document positions for complex-RoPE blocks, the call site silently fell through to global positions and the rotary phase still depended on global token index across packed boundaries.
target_bugs.invariant: Per-document positions used by complex-RoPE must reset at each cu_doc_lens boundary; identical packed documents must yield identical post-RoPE q/k.

target_bugs.title: Trainer async bookkeeping callback fires after future is FINISHED — state_dict snapshot can capture pre-callback state
target_bugs.root_cause: _run_bookkeeping_op attached cb via future.add_done_callback. add_done_callback runs after the future is marked FINISHED, so _join_bookkeeping_ops returned before cb ran, and a state_dict() capture immediately after could observe stale callback state (e.g., un-rotated checkpoint indexes).
target_bugs.invariant: All bookkeeping callbacks for a future must complete before that future transitions to FINISHED so _join_bookkeeping_ops waits on them too.

target_bugs.title: Grad clipper recorded grad_norm DTensor — record_metric saw distributed value
target_bugs.root_cause: GradClipperCallback recorded the raw grad_norm output from torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_ without unwrapping it. With TP, this returned a DTensor; the metric system then operated on the DTensor across ranks, producing a wrongly reduced grad-norm value while clipping itself was already applied locally.
target_bugs.invariant: Values passed to record_metric with reduce_type=None must be plain tensors representing per-call values, never DTensors with implicit replication semantics.

target_bugs.title: NaN loss when all instances on a rank are masked — division by zero
target_bugs.root_cause: batch_num_tokens_for_loss = 0 when all instances masked, causing loss / 0 = NaN
target_bugs.invariant: batch_num_tokens_for_loss must be > 0 to avoid NaN in loss computation

target_bugs.title: BLT distill metric not divided by num_micro_batches when grad_accum_steps>1
target_bugs.root_cause: batch_metrics accumulated detached metric tensors across micro-batches without dividing by num_micro_batches, so logged BLT decoder losses were inflated by the gradient accumulation factor while training itself proceeded normally.
target_bugs.invariant: Per-batch logged metrics should equal the average over micro-batches, not the sum.

target_bugs.title: FlashAttn sliding-window off-by-one — window included one too many tokens
target_bugs.root_cause: Attention.__init__ stored self.window_size = (window_size, 0) when configuring sliding-window attention. Flash-attention's window is closed-interval [i - window_size[0], i + window_size[1]], so passing window_size directly let token i attend to window_size + 1 past tokens instead of window_size.
target_bugs.invariant: After configuration, the actual receptive window of each token under sliding attention must equal exactly the configured window_size positions.

target_bugs.title: BLT byte embeddings never initialized to teacher-embedding stats — kept default kaiming
target_bugs.root_cause: fix_init computed te_mean and te_std of the target embeddings but used them only when initializing hash_embeddings; the main self.embedding.weight (byte embeddings) was never assigned the te-scaled init, leaving it at nn.Embedding's default initialization. The encoder therefore started training with byte embeddings whose distribution did not match the teacher's vocabulary embeddings.
target_bugs.invariant: When a teacher embedding source is provided, the byte embedding must be sampled from a distribution with the same per-channel mean/std as the teacher embeddings.

target_bugs.title: TE attention backend silently ignored cu_doc_lens — intra-doc masking not applied
target_bugs.root_cause: TEAttentionBackend.forward accepted cu_doc_lens / max_doc_len arguments but did not pass them to TransformerEngine's attn kernel. Documents packed into a single sequence cross-attended each other instead of being masked at boundaries — full attention across all packed docs.
target_bugs.invariant: When cu_doc_lens is supplied, attention from token i must be limited to its own document; the TE backend must either honor cu_doc_lens or refuse the call.

target_bugs.title: BLT stage1 froze only teacher.* — student blocks updated against teacher gradient
target_bugs.root_cause: freeze_params=['teacher.*'] only matched submodules named 'teacher.*'. Because share_blocks_between_teacher_and_student=True, the actual block parameters live under 'blocks.*' (shared with teacher); those weren't matched by the freeze pattern, so blocks were unfrozen and trained against gradients that included contributions from the teacher path.
target_bugs.invariant: freeze_params patterns must match every parameter that should remain frozen, including shared submodule names.

target_bugs.title: MultiHeadLatentAttention init dispatched to Attention branch — wrong layers initialized
target_bugs.root_cause: InitMethod.init_attention dispatched on isinstance(m, Attention) before isinstance hasattr(m, 'wq_a'). Because MultiHeadLatentAttention inherits from Attention and exposes w_q, the MLA branch was never reached; the projections wq_a, wkv_a, wkv_b were never initialized while only w_q was, leaving the rest at the dtype-empty allocation values.
target_bugs.invariant: Every nn.Linear weight in attention sub-modules must be initialized exactly once via the appropriate init_attention branch before training starts.

target_bugs.title: Instance packing ladder set source_group_size on both Packing source and parent — double counting
target_bugs.root_cause: instance_packing_ladder set source_group_size=8 on both the inner NumpyDocumentSourceMixConfig and the outer PackingInstanceSourceConfig. The two interact multiplicatively in the source-permutation logic, so the effective grouping was 64 documents per group instead of the intended 8, changing the packing distribution silently.
target_bugs.invariant: source_group_size must be specified at exactly one layer of the source pipeline; duplicating it across nested configs changes the actual grouping by a multiplicative factor.

target_bugs.title: Qwen3Clone-8B script forgot use_head_qk_norm — used per-channel QK norm instead of per-head
target_bugs.root_cause: build_model_config for Qwen3Clone-8B configured the Qwen3 model but did not set config.block.attention.use_head_qk_norm = True. Qwen3 uses per-head QK norm; the default per-channel QK norm was applied instead, normalizing across the wrong axis and producing different attention scores from the reference Qwen3.
target_bugs.invariant: Model factories that clone HF reference models must set every option that affects forward semantics to match the reference, including use_head_qk_norm for Qwen3.

target_bugs.title: BLT debias used log(sum(exp(logprobs))) — silent underflow on small probabilities
target_bugs.root_cause: y_space_hat_all = log(einsum(exp(logprobs), space_mask).float()). exp() of low logprobs underflows to 0 in fp32, the masked sum collapses to 0, and log(0) = -inf is added into y_hat in-place. Subsequent loss terms silently propagate -inf values rather than failing.
target_bugs.invariant: All log-domain reductions should be performed via torch.logsumexp on a where-masked tensor instead of log(sum(exp(...))) over a multiplicative mask.

target_bugs.title: H-Net ratio loss averaged over padded positions — wrong target ratio under variable-length batches
target_bugs.root_cause: true_ratio = boundary_mask.float().mean() and average_prob = exp(boundary_logprobs).mean() averaged over the full padded byte tensor instead of over byte_mask-valid positions. Padded zero entries shrank both quantities toward 0, biasing the ratio loss target away from the true content ratio.
target_bugs.invariant: Any loss-target statistic over a variable-length sequence must be (x*mask).mean() / mask.mean(), not x.mean().

target_bugs.title: H-Net embed loss never normalized by loss_div_factor — wrong loss weighting
target_bugs.root_cause: The BLTDistillTransformer finalize block called self._finalize_loss on local_encoder_loss and local_decoder_loss but omitted the call for hnet_embed_loss. The component was added to the weighted-sum loss as a raw sum (not divided by token count), so its effective weight was inflated by approximately seq_len * batch_size relative to the configured loss_weights entry.
target_bugs.invariant: All loss components that appear in the weighted combination must be passed through _finalize_loss with the appropriate loss_div_factor.

target_bugs.title: BLTDistill patch loss div factor used input_ids.numel() — wrong scaling for byte-level losses
target_bugs.root_cause: The byte-level loss div factor was computed as loss_div_factor / input_ids.numel(), but loss_div_factor passed in is at the byte sequence level not the patch level. The correct denominator is h_byte.shape[0] * h_byte.shape[1] (number of byte positions), and the patch loss needs an analogous division by patch positions. The mismatch silently mis-weighted byte vs patch loss components.
target_bugs.invariant: Each loss component must be divided by the number of valid positions of that component's granularity (bytes vs patches), not by input_ids.numel().

target_bugs.title: Sliding window size off-by-one — window 1 token too small
BLT distill missed first-call label_offsets when fuse_boundaries enabled
target_bugs.root_cause: The label-offset application path that conditionally adds vocab_size_blt to boundary positions was duplicated for the alternate boundary computation but missed in the first forward branch. Boundary positions did not get their offsets applied to labels, so the cross-entropy compared against the wrong target indices for boundary tokens.
target_bugs.invariant: When fuse_boundaries is enabled, every boundary position in labels must receive the +vocab_size_blt offset before being compared against the joint vocab logits.

target_bugs.title: BLT shift_boundary_mask did not AND with byte_mask — pad positions polluted label offsets
target_bugs.root_cause: shift_boundary_mask was computed as boundary_mask[:, 1:] without AND-ing with byte_mask[:, 1:]. Padded positions where boundary_mask happened to be True (left-over from a previous batch slot) added vocab_size_blt//2 to label entries that should have remained at the ignore_index, distorting CE on padded positions.
target_bugs.invariant: Any operation that mutates labels at boundary positions must restrict its mask via AND with the active byte_mask so padded positions are untouched.

target_bugs.title: SourceMixtureDataset rounded down per-source instances — dataset shorter than expected
target_bugs.root_cause: tokens_requested_per_path = ceil(target_ratio * num_tokens_in_path) and instances_requested_per_path = tokens_requested_per_path // sequence_length. The integer-floor in the second step dropped the per-path remainder, so total instances < training_steps * batch_size. The trainer ran past the end of the dataset into epoch 2 with no warning — visible only as an unexpected loss drop near end of run.
target_bugs.invariant: sum(instances_per_path) must equal training_steps * batch_size; any rounding-down must be redistributed (e.g. via Hamilton's largest-remainder method) so the trainer never wraps to epoch 2.

target_bugs.title: Attention gate w_g never initialized — uses uninitialized memory
target_bugs.root_cause: init_attention initialized w_q/w_k/w_v (and w_qkv for FusedAttention) but never touched the optional gate projection w_g. When constructed via nn.Linear with init_device='meta'/'cpu', w_g.weight held whatever values reset_parameters or torch.empty produced rather than the intended trunc-normal distribution.
target_bugs.invariant: Every learnable Linear weight in attention (including the optional gate projection) must be initialized exactly once via _init_linear before training starts.

target_bugs.title: PoE z_loss combined into combined_loss is detached, contributing value but no gradient
target_bugs.root_cause: In TransformerTrainModule.train_batch the PoE branch added output.z_loss to combined_loss, but LMHead emits output.z_loss as a detached metric tensor. The optimizer therefore saw the z_loss value in the printed metric while backprop applied zero z_loss gradient, so logit-norm regularization never actually constrained the weights.
target_bugs.invariant: Any tensor summed into combined_loss prior to backward() must have requires_grad=True so the regularizer reaches the parameters.

target_bugs.title: soft_ce branch backprops only alpha*soft_ce — hard_ce gradient zeroed because output.ce_loss is detached
target_bugs.root_cause: The soft-CE branch built combined_loss = (1-alpha)*hard_ce_loss + alpha*soft_ce_loss + z_loss using output.ce_loss and output.z_loss, both of which LMHead returns as .detach()'d copies. Only output.loss carries gradient. As soon as alpha decayed to 0 the entire backward() saw zero gradient and grad_norm collapsed.
target_bugs.invariant: grad_norm must remain positive when (1-alpha) > 0; the (1-alpha) coefficient on hard CE must contribute non-zero parameter gradient.

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Ping-pong buffer index reset causes gradient reduction data race
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: self.index = 0 resets buffer index at wrong point, causing reduce_ipg_grads to use stale data
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: Ping-pong buffer index must not be reset between gradient reduce calls

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: ZeRO3 uses default_stream instead of current_stream for gradient reduce
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: reduce_and_partition_stream.wait_stream uses default_stream() instead of current_stream()
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: ZeRO3 reduce must wait on current_stream(), not default_stream()

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Residual MoE softmax applied on wrong dimension
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: softmax(coef, dim=1) should be dim=-1 for correct expert coefficient normalization
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: softmax dim must be -1 (expert dim), not hardcoded 1

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: MoE CPU offload grad norm tensor stays on CPU instead of GPU
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: scaled_norm_tensor not moved to GPU before norm computation with CUDA tensors
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: CPU-offloaded grad norm tensor must be moved to accelerator device

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Grad norm NaN handling uses wrong tensor operation (logical_or)
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: inf_or_nan = norm_is_nan.logical_or(norm_is_inf) computes scalar-tensor op incorrectly
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: NaN/inf check must use Python or/and, not tensor logical_or on scalar results

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Mixture rounding error causing sample repetition
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: Missing global_batch_size in SourceMixtureDatasetConfig causes rounding error
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: Config must include global_batch_size for proper allocation

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: SourceMixtureDatasetConfig overrides global random seed
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: build() calls random.seed(self.seed), corrupting global RNG state
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: build() must not call global random.seed()

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Incorrect label_mask tensor creation in NumpyPaddedFSLDataset
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: torch.ones_like(input_ids) creates int64 mask, padded with pad_token_id instead of bool+False
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: label_mask must be bool dtype with False padding

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Incorrect gradient computation in ZeRO-2 with DeepSpeed >= 0.17.6
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: ZeRO-2 backward pass 中梯度计算存在回归 bug，导致梯度范数显著偏低（从 4.7-6.0 降到 1.6-3.2），训练质量悄然退化
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: ZeRO-2 下梯度范数相比 ZeRO-1/ZeRO-3 显著偏小

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: DistributedAttention produces numerically incorrect results when sequence length is not divisible by world size
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: SeqAllToAll 在序列长度不能被 world_size 整除时产生错误的 uneven split，输出与参考实现有 max abs diff ~0.68 的偏差
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: DistributedAttention 输出与本地 attention 参考实现的 max abs diff 异常大

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: DeepSpeed accuracy issue for torch.compile if activation checkpoint function not compiler disabled
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: DeepSpeed 自定义 checkpoint 函数与 torch.compile 不兼容，RNG state 保存/恢复机制不匹配导致 dropout 在 forward/backward 间产生不同随机数，loss 逐步发散
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: loss 随训练步数缓慢发散（40000 步后 6.09 vs 期望 5.12）；启用 torch.compile 时 loss 与不启用时不同

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Fix wrong idx bug in invertible LayerNormBackward1
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: LayerNormBackward1 CUDA kernel 中 gamma/beta 数组访问时用了 pos (threadIdx.y) 而非 idx (threadIdx.x)，导致 gamma 梯度计算使用了错误的索引
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: LayerNorm backward 的 gamma 梯度与参考实现 checksum 不同

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Fixed the problem of loading universal checkpoint error in multi-machine mode
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: 多机环境下 stage3 universal checkpoint 加载逻辑存在 bug，导致加载后 loss 异常升高而非从断点恢复
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: checkpoint resume 后 loss 异常升高而非从保存点继续

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: reduce_bucket_size influences training convergence of Zero2
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: reduce_bucket_size 本应仅影响通信效率，但实际影响了训练收敛：不同 bucket size 导致显著不同的 loss 曲线，极小值会导致 NaN
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: 仅改变 reduce_bucket_size 即导致 loss 曲线显著变化

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Fix the universal checkpoint issue for stage3 with multiple subgroups
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: stage3 universal checkpoint 未正确处理多 subgroup 场景，tensor slicing 越界；多进程同时写入同一 checkpoint 文件导致竞争条件和数据损坏
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: universal checkpoint 转换时 tensor 访问越界；多进程写入同一文件导致 checksum 不稳定

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Wrong attention gradient when Context Parallelism is on
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: dQ, dK, dV output from the backward function of core_attention are wrong when context parallelism is enabled. Activation gradients have relative error as large as 1.2 compared to single-card training.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: Attention gradient norm/checksum deviates significantly from single-GPU reference; relative error > 1.0 in dQ/dK/dV

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: RoPE ignores position IDs with --reset-position-ids
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: When --reset-position-ids is used, RoPE always uses positions 0 to seq_len-1 instead of the actual position IDs. Rotary embeddings do not account for enc_position_ids, producing incorrect positional encodings.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: RoPE embedding values are identical regardless of actual position IDs; position 0-N used even when reset is active

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: torch.compile recompile limit breaks autograd graph in PPO loop, silently incorrect gradients
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: In PPO training loops, requires_grad state switching causes torch.compile to hit recompile limit. This breaks the autograd graph, and c10d::broadcast_ without registered autograd kernel leads to silently incorrect gradients.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: Gradient values are incorrect after torch.compile recompile limit is hit; broadcast_ operations not tracked in autograd

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Loss error when using Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: MLA implementation produces unexpected loss values with megatron-core 0.10.0. Training proceeds without errors but produces abnormal loss patterns, indicating incorrect attention computation.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: Loss values are abnormal compared to non-MLA reference; attention output may be numerically incorrect

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: [BUG] Wrong attention gradient in Transformer Engine
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: Fused attention backward pass (fused_attn_bwd) produces dQ with relative error >1.0 for deep models, silently corrupting gradients when using TE fused attention with TP.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: Attention gradient relative error exceeds 1.0 compared to non-fused reference; grad_norm abnormally large

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: [Bug]: Attention Mask Ignored in transformer_engine Backend with Packed Sequences
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: TE layer defaults to attn_mask_type='causal' and silently ignores the block-diagonal attention_mask, causing cross-document attention leakage during packed-sequence training.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: Attention output with packed sequences differs from expected block-diagonal masked output; cross-document attention leakage

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Possible RoPE frequency format mismatch in MultiLatentAttention when rotary_interleaved=True
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: YarnRotaryEmbedding is instantiated without forwarding rotary_interleaved from config, generating half-half layout frequencies applied with interleaved logic, silently corrupting positional encodings.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: RoPE embedding values differ from expected when rotary_interleaved=True; positional encoding corrupted

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Removed buggy fused cross-entropy loss variant that consistently under-performed
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: Fused cross-entropy loss 实现存在 bug，导致 loss 计算结果始终低于原生 PyTorch 实现（compiled 后），严重到需要 Post Incident Report 和完全移除该实现
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: fused CE loss 与 native PyTorch CE loss 的计算结果不一致；训练效果持续不佳

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Fixed ReorderedNormTransformerBlock with fine-grained FSDP wrapping + activation checkpointing
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: ReorderedNormTransformerBlock 在同时使用 fine-grained FSDP wrapping 和 activation checkpointing 时出现交互 bug，产生不正确的计算结果
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: fine-grained FSDP + activation checkpointing 组合下，forward/backward 结果与未使用时不一致

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Source mixture datasets truncating source files instead of randomly sampling
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: SourceMixtureDataset 在需要采样数据时错误地截断源文件而非随机采样，导致训练只使用了每个源文件的前 N 条数据
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: 数据使用分布偏向每个源文件的开头部分；实际训练数据覆盖率低于预期

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: torch.ops.fsdp.set_ with torch.compile silently incorrect due to CSE optimization
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: FSDP 的 set_ 操作未被 functionalized，torch.compile 的 CSE 优化错误地消除了 set_ 之后的重复表达式，导致静默产生错误结果
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: torch.compile + FSDP 下计算结果与 eager mode 不一致；set_ 之后的操作返回了 set_ 之前的值

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Meta device initialization on HF models + FSDP leads to different numerical behavior
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: HuggingFace 模型使用 meta device 初始化后再 move to GPU + FSDP wrap，与直接 GPU 初始化相比产生不同的数值结果，即使 buffers/parameters 看起来相同
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: meta device 初始化 vs GPU 直接初始化的 loss 输出不同；参数值看起来相同但计算结果不同

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: FSDP2 precision issues in reverse process: gradient precision degradation with block-level wrapping
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: FSDP2 对 model block 逐个 fully_shard() 再 wrap 整个模型时，backward 中 text layer 的 gradient 出现精度问题，单 GPU 也能复现
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.detection_method: block-level FSDP wrapping 与 whole-model wrapping 的 gradient 精度不同；单 GPU + FSDP 也出现精度退化

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: cross_entropy_loss z-loss reduction='mean' uses wrong masked-mean formula
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: buggy: z_squared = z_squared / (labels != ignore).mean() returns vector divided by scalar, wrong scaling. Fix: z_squared = (z_squared * (labels != ignore)).mean() returns scalar masked-mean.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: olmo.train.cross_entropy_loss z_loss with reduction='mean' must equal 1e-4 * masked_mean(logsumexp**2 of valid tokens)

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Trainer.train_micro_batch divides z_loss by num_micro_batches instead of batch_size_in_tokens
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: z_loss = z_loss / num_micro_batches scales auxiliary loss by gradient accumulation count, not by token count. With T=batch_size_in_tokens >> num_micro_batches, z_loss dominates loss and corrupts training.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: z_loss returned by train_micro_batch must equal raw_z_loss / batch_size_in_tokens (same divisor as ce_loss)

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: TopKGate applies topk to logits instead of post-softmax gates
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: torch.topk(logits, k) selects experts from raw logits, not softmax probabilities
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: topk must be applied to gates (post-softmax), not logits (pre-softmax)

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: ZeRO-3 reduce_and_partition_stream syncs against wrong CUDA stream
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: __add_grad_to_ipg_bucket uses default_stream() instead of current_stream() for reduce_and_partition_stream synchronization
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: Stream synchronization must use current_stream() not default_stream() to prevent race conditions

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Loss double-scaling in backward — scale_if_loss applied to gas_scaled_loss
ZeRO++ all_to_all_quant_reduce hard-codes gpu_per_node=16 — wrong intra-node split on every non-16-GPU node
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: csrc/quantization/pt_binding.cpp::quantized_reduction had `const int gpu_per_node = 16;` hard-coded. The Python wrapper all_to_all_quant_reduce passes the actual local_world_size, but the C++ side ignored it. Buffer slicing inside the kernel (sz.back() / gpu_per_node, in_groups / gpu_per_node, elems_per_in_tensor / gpu_per_node) is therefore done with the wrong divisor on any non-16-GPU node — row
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: Inside quantized_reduction, the divisor used to compute elems_per_in_tensor must equal the actual intra-node world size (devices_per_node argument), not a constant.

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: ZeRO-2 ipg double-buffer swap not synchronized — current backward writes into bucket while previous reduce still reads
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: In ipg_remove_grads, after triggering an async reduce_ipg_grads on bucket index k, the code immediately swaps `bucket.index = 1 - bucket.index` so the next gradient writes into bucket index (1-k). Without an explicit reduction_stream <-> current_stream wait, the backward kernel writing into bucket (1-k) on the current stream can begin before the previous reduce-scatter on bucket k has finished — a
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: Before swapping ipg bucket index after a reduce, default stream must wait for reduction_stream to complete on accelerators where resolves_data_dependency()==False.

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: ZeRO 1/2 reduction stream not waited by current stream — ipg_buffer rewrite races allreduce when comm > compute
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: In average_tensor (overlap_comm path), reduction_stream did wait_stream(current_stream) so the allreduce waits for backward to finish populating the buffer, but current_stream did NOT wait_stream(reduction_stream) afterwards. When backward of the next bucket completes faster than the previous allreduce, the next gradient gets written into the same ipg_buffer slot that allreduce is still reading, c
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: On an accelerator without automatic data-dep resolution, after triggering an async reduce on the reduction_stream, current_stream must wait for reduction_stream before reusing the IPG buffer.

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Sequence parallel single_all_to_all reshape collapses batch and seq dims — QKV permuted into wrong tokens
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: single_all_to_all's reshape for the head-scatter path used `[seq_world_size, inp_shape[scatter_idx]] + inp_shape[scatter_idx+1:]` and then transposed (0,2). This collapses batch and sequence into a single dimension and reorders elements such that after the all_to_all+reshape back, query[b,s,h] no longer corresponds to the same logical token. Pre-attention QKV are permuted into the wrong (b,s,h) po
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: For an identity test (round-trip _SeqAllToAll(scatter, gather) followed by _SeqAllToAll(gather, scatter)), output must equal input element-wise.

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: ZeRO-3 init broadcast tracked through autograd — backward through synchronization op silently corrupts gradients
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: In DeepSpeedEngine._broadcast_model, dist.broadcast(p, ...) was invoked on the parameter Tensor itself (which has requires_grad=True). c10d::broadcast_ has no registered autograd kernel; PyTorch falls through with a warning that explicitly states 'may lead to silently incorrect behavior'. When the user later calls loss.backward(), autograd traverses the broadcast op as part of the computation grap
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: Tensor operations performed for cross-rank state synchronization at init must not be on autograd's recorded computation graph (must be inside torch.no_grad() or use .data).

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: ZeRO++ secondary partition copy not synchronized — prefetch all-gather reads garbage
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: _partition_param_sec issued an asynchronous device-to-device copy from the full param into ds_secondary_tensor (via .narrow(...).copy_()) but never recorded a stream-synchronization at the end. The next allgather of ds_secondary_tensor (launched by the prefetch coordinator) could be enqueued before the copy completed. Because both ops live on the same device but on different streams, the reader st
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: After _partition_param_sec, get_accelerator().current_stream().synchronize() must complete before any consumer of param.ds_secondary_tensor (e.g. _all_gather_dtype) is enqueued.

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: MoE sigmoid score adds expert_bias before sigmoid normalization, distorting probs
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: topk_softmax_with_capacity sigmoid branch added expert_bias inside logits_fp32 BEFORE applying sigmoid, then later applied sigmoid only on a different branch. Result: expert_bias was added to raw logits and saturated through sigmoid, producing wrong scores while top_indices were still computed on the biased pre-sigmoid scores.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: Final routing scores must equal sigmoid(logits.float()) gathered at top_indices; expert_bias must only affect routing selection, not the probability values used for combining expert outputs.

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: MoE input jitter applied AFTER gating instead of before, jittering gradients not inputs
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: TopKRouter.routing called self.apply_input_jitter(logits) AFTER computing logits = self.gating(input). The intent of input jitter is to perturb the router input, not the logits; jittering logits instead changes Z-loss reference and z-loss gradient direction, silently degrading load balancing.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: apply_input_jitter must be called on the router input tensor before self.gating(input), not on logits after gating.

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: GPTDataset returns aliased cached_loss_mask, downstream in-place padding mutates the shared cache and corrupts later sam
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: In the cached-mask branch, GPTDataset assigned loss_mask = self.cached_loss_mask, returning the cached tensor by reference instead of a clone. Downstream code in the same __getitem__ path applies in-place modifications (e.g. zeroing the loss for pad tokens). The first sample with padding silently mutates the shared cache, so every subsequent sample served from the cache starts from a polluted mask
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: GPTDataset.cached_loss_mask must equal a tensor of all-ones at the start of every __getitem__ call.

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: grad_norm_exp_avg EMA self-referential update — adaptive clipping broken
Restart in later epochs uses seed+epoch as PRNG seed, mixing epoch into seed irreversibly and corrupting reshuffle
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: IterableDataset was constructed with seed=seed+(train_config.epoch or 0) and reshuffle() did self.seed += 1. After a restart at epoch=N the dataset received seed+N as base and then was incremented again, producing a different shuffle order than the original run had used at the same epoch. This silently changed the data ordering across resumes.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: the global indices produced by IterableDataset for (seed, epoch) must be identical across a fresh run and a resumed run

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: IterableDataset leftover indices distributed wrongly across workers
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: When distributing the leftover (unaligned) indices across workers, the buggy code did `left_overs = indices[truncated_size + worker_info.id : truncated_size + worker_info.id + worker_info.num_workers]`, which gives each worker a contiguous slice of `num_workers` indices starting at its id (so workers overlap and miss other leftovers). The fix uses strided slicing `indices[truncated_size + worker_i
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: Union of leftover indices across all workers must equal the full set of leftover indices, with no overlap

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: Flex-attention sliding-window mask used Python `and` on tensors — short-circuit returned wrong mask
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: _get_flex_attn_mask_mod._sliding_window_mask_mod returned `q_idx - kv_idx <= window_size[0] and kv_idx - q_idx <= window_size[1]`. Python's `and` calls bool() on the first operand and short-circuits — for scalar bool tensors this returns the second operand whenever the first is truthy and the first when falsy, never producing the intended logical AND. The mask was therefore computed as a single on
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: Mask-mod functions for flex_attention must use torch.logical_and / & on tensors, never Python's `and`/`or`.

unobservable_bugs_audit_only.title: InvSqrt LR schedule wrong scheduler chosen for OLMoE3 — Cos used where WSD intended
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.root_cause: OLMoE3-3B-27B used CosWithWarmup with only warmup_steps configured. Without an explicit decay schedule the optimizer ran cosine decay from peak lr to alpha_f over the full training horizon, instead of the WSD (warmup-stable-decay) schedule the recipe intended. The lr trajectory was silently cosine-shaped instead of WSD-shaped.
unobservable_bugs_audit_only.invariant: WSD-style training recipes must use the WSD scheduler with explicit warmup, decay step counts, and decay_fraction=None — not CosWithWarmup, even though both yield monotonic lr curves.
